name: pi-chisel
description: A native Pi prompt-optimizer extension for polishing unsent drafts.

scripts.format: biome check --write src test package.json tsconfig.json --files-ignore-unknown=true
scripts.lint: biome check src test package.json tsconfig.json --files-ignore-unknown=true
scripts.validate: npm run lint && npm run check && npm test && npm run test:smoke && npm run smoke:configured
